yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: Love your enemies, pray for persecutors.
days.teaching: Highest hill of love. Month focus — Loving the Unlovable — Enemies & Persecutors: Bless, forgive, reconcile. This week we carry "Thanksgiving and Praise" (Psalm 100:4). Spiritual Strength & Growth flows from being loved first. Let Matthew 5:44 settle you: Love your enemies, pray for persecutors.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Fill me with hunger for Your Word. Let my faith rise, my prayer catch fire, and my roots go deep in Your love.
days.declaration: I am rooted and established in the eternal love of God.
days.decree: I am rooted and established in the eternal love of God. Love your enemies, pray for persecutors. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Read your day scripture aloud 3x and write one obedience step.

Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Exclusivity protects. Month focus — Loving the Unlovable — Enemies & Persecutors: Bless, forgive, reconcile. This week we carry "The End of the Matter" (Ecclesiastes 12:13). Mental Maturity & Clarity flows from being loved first. Let James 4:4 settle you: Friendship with the world is enmity. Now declare: I have the mind of Christ; confusion has no hold on me. Friendship with the world is enmity. In Jesus’ name, Amen. You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: You cannot serve two masters.
days.teaching: One throne, one King. Month focus — Loving the Unlovable — Enemies & Persecutors: Bless, forgive, reconcile. This week we carry "The End of the Matter" (Ecclesiastes 12:13). Physical Strength & Endurance flows from being loved first. Let Matthew 6:24 settle you: You cannot serve two masters.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Strengthen this temple. Give me vitality and endurance to run my race to the crown.
days.declaration: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion.
days.decree: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion. You cannot serve two masters. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Walk 10 minutes praying the declaration; honour rest and water today.
